commands.description: Every entry becomes a row in the Cockpit sidebar.

id.description: Stable identifier, used to remember argument values. Defaults to the label.

description.description: Greyed-out text next to the label.

command.description: Base command line. Arguments are appended to it, correctly quoted for the active shell.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the workspace folder.

group.description: Optional heading. Commands sharing a group are nested under it.

icon.description: A VS Code codicon name, without the $() wrapper.

env.description: Extra environment variables for this command.

confirm.description: Always show the assembled command line for confirmation before running.

resetAfterRun.description: Clear every remembered value for this command once it has been launched. An argument with its own "default" reverts to that default rather than "not set" - only the remembered override is cleared. Good for one-off values like a branch name, where reusing last run's value by accident is risky.

args.description: Arguments the user can set from the sidebar.

id.description: Unique within the command. Used as the storage key for the remembered value.

enumDescriptions: Dropdown with a fixed list of options.
Dropdown whose options come from the output of a shell command, one per line.
On/off switch that appends its flag when on.
Multi-select list; the chosen values are joined by `separator`.

label.description: Name shown in the sidebar. Defaults to the id.

description.description: Help text shown in the prompt and tooltip.

flag.description: Emitted before the value, e.g. "-TargetEnv" or "--target". Omit for a positional argument. For `flag` kind, this is what gets appended when the switch is on.

default.description: Value used until the user sets one. For `pick`/`multiPick` you can instead mark individual entries in "options" with their own "default": true, which is often easier to read than repeating the value here.

required.description: If true, Cockpit prompts for this argument when you run the command and it is still empty.

remember.description: Remember the last used value. Defaults to the cockpit.rememberArguments setting.

placeholder.description: Hint text inside an empty input box.

options.description: Choices for `pick` and `multiPick`. Use a plain string when the label and the value are the same.

value.description: Passed on the command line. Defaults to the label.

default.description: Pre-selects this option. For `pick`, mark at most one option. For `multiPick`, every marked option starts selected. Ignored if the arg itself also sets a "default".

command.description: For `shellPick`: the command to run. Each non-empty line of stdout becomes one option.

cwd.description: For `shellPick`: where to run `command`, relative to the workspace folder.

separator.description: For `multiPick`: what to join the selected values with.
